notes:
August 29th 2026
Version 13.7+ (stable) / 13.8+ (beta)
**********************
NEW!
* Volume Mixer: every section's level side by side, like a mixing desk. (R)
* Normalize one program with a before-and-after preview. (R)
* Programs needing an expansion pack you don't have are now marked in the list. (R)
* Expansion Pack Usage now suggests the best four packs for your file. (R)
* New Window menu - jump between open windows with Ctrl+1, Ctrl+2... (K,R)
* See Help->Show Release Notes for More...
